epics.title: Institutional Security & Perimeter Token/PIN Authorization Barrier
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, instructor, or resident accesses the CRIE portal, I want strict perimeter authentication via institutional token or service PIN, so that unauthorized external access is completely blocked and compliance with 152-FZ data protection requirements is maintained.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero unauthorized endpoint access attempts passing perimeter without valid institutional token
requirements: R1: Enforce mandatory institutional token/PIN modal gate in UI and return HTTP 401 Unauthorized for unauthenticated API requests

slices.title: Enforce mandatory institutional token/PIN perimeter barrier and 401 API guard
slices.jtbd: When implementing perimeter access control for this epic, I want to block unauthenticated API requests with 401 status and trigger the institutional token/PIN entry modal, so that unauthorized external access is completely blocked in compliance with 152-FZ.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated visitor, When any application page or API endpoint is requested, Then a 401 Unauthorized response is returned and the institutional token/PIN verification modal is displayed.
Given a valid institutional credential submitted via the modal, When verified against the auth endpoint, Then a session token is issued, subsequent requests succeed with 200 OK, and automated regression tests verify 401 enforcement across all secured endpoints.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% interception rate with 401 Unauthorized for requests lacking institutional token

epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero technical disk paths or placeholder stubs shown across all 1,697 document catalog cards
requirements: R1: Eliminate copy path buttons, raw file system paths, and database verified stub text across catalog search cards and consultant replies
R2: Provide direct functional DOCX/PDF download buttons for all 1,697 normative corpus catalog documents

slices.title: Sanitize catalog cards and enable direct file download links for normative documents
slices.jtbd: When implementing catalog item presentation for this epic, I want to eliminate raw filesystem paths and copy-path buttons while exposing direct file download buttons for all 1,697 catalog records, so that users receive clean document access without technical noise.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given any of the 1,697 records in the catalog search interface or consultant chat, When the document card is rendered, Then no raw file system paths or 'Скопировать путь' buttons or stub strings appear, and a human-readable title and metadata are displayed.
Given a rendered document card in search results, When the user clicks the direct download button, Then the genuine DOCX or PDF file is downloaded via the download API endpoint with valid headers and unit/E2E tests pass.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of catalog items display direct download buttons with zero raw file paths

epics.title: Personal AI Regulatory Assistant & GOST Order Generator
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, instructor, or resident needs regulatory guidance or administrative drafts, I want an AI assistant grounded in institutional knowledge and a one-click GOST R 7.0.97-2016 .docx order generator, so that official administrative tasks are executed accurately in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% schema and typography compliance for generated examination schedule DOCX documents according to GOST R 7.0.97-2016
requirements: R1: Implement GOST R 7.0.97-2016 compliant DOCX generation for examination session schedules covering groups 25ОЭ, 26ОЭ, 25ОИ, 26ОИ, 25ОП, 26ОП and postgraduate students for 25.01 to 25.02 with direct one-click download

slices.title: Implement GOST-compliant examination schedule generation for residency and postgraduate groups
slices.jtbd: When implementing the academic document generator for this epic, I want to produce official GOST R 7.0.97-2016 DOCX examination session schedules for groups 25ОЭ, 26ОЭ, 25ОИ, 26ОИ, 25ОП, 26ОП and postgraduates for 25.01-25.02, so that official examination schedules can be exported in one click.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an examination schedule generation request specifying groups 25ОЭ, 26ОЭ, 25ОИ, 26ОИ, 25ОП, 26ОП and postgraduate programs for the period 25.01-25.02, When the document generator is executed, Then a valid DOCX file structured according to GOST R 7.0.97-2016 with complete examination tables is produced and saved to the download directory.
Given the generated examination schedule file, When downloaded via the download endpoint, Then the response contains valid Word document MIME headers and automated schema validation tests verify document integrity.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% adherence to GOST R 7.0.97-2016 formatting and complete group schedule coverage
